_statement_on_model_call: The model call happens exclusively inside the host agent reasoning loop AFTER tools/list discovers schemas and BEFORE tools/call dispatches arguments; the MCP server never invokes or hosts an LLM.

_annotations.jsonrpc: Protocol specification version identifier (must be exactly '2.0').
_annotations.id: Unique request identifier used by the client to correlate asynchronous JSON-RPC responses.
_annotations.method: The RPC method being invoked ('initialize' performs handshake and capability negotiation).
_annotations.params: Input container specifying the client's supported MCP protocol version and client metadata.

_annotations.jsonrpc: Protocol specification version confirmed by server ('2.0').
_annotations.id: Matching request identifier (1) confirming this response answers the initialize handshake.
_annotations.result: Container holding server capability flags and server metadata.
_annotations.capabilities: Feature map declaring that the server supports tools and resources.

_annotations.id: Unique correlation identifier for the tool discovery query (2).
_annotations.method: Standard MCP discovery method ('tools/list') requesting all callable tools.
_annotations.params: Empty object indicating no pagination cursor is needed for initial discovery.

tools.name: get_package_versions
tools.description: Retrieve all published release versions, release dates, and current latest stable version for a package from the registry.

tools.name: get_deprecation_notice
tools.description: Query package registry deprecation notices, sunset dates, and replacement packages for a specified package and version.

tools.name: get_release_metadata
tools.description: Fetch package release metadata including maintainer, license, release timestamp, and repository URL.

_annotations.id: Matching request identifier (2) confirming response to tools/list.
_annotations.result: Payload container holding the discovered tool definitions.
_annotations.tools: Array of callable tool objects defining name, docstring/description, and JSON Schema input parameter contracts.

_annotations.id: Unique correlation identifier for the execution request (3).
_annotations.method: Standard MCP dispatch method ('tools/call') instructing server to run a tool.
_annotations.params: Specifies target tool name ('get_package_versions') and keyword arguments validated against inputSchema.

_annotations.id: Matching request identifier (3) confirming response to tools/call.
_annotations.result: Container holding execution output blocks and error status flags.
_annotations.content: Array of content blocks returned by the tool (plain text, markdown, or JSON payloads).
_annotations.isError: Boolean flag indicating whether tool execution encountered an unhandled or fatal error (false indicates successful execution).
